steps.code:
# Compute most common genre for each playlist and update titles
from collections import Counter

for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    most_common = Counter(genres).most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pl['playlist_id']}: {pl['title']} -> {new_title}")
    apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pl['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
